name: PM-KISAN
benefit: ₹6,000 per year paid in three equal installments
next_action: Visit your nearest CSC with your Aadhaar and land record to register

name: PMFBY (Crop Insurance)
benefit: Insurance cover against crop failure due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases
next_action: Enroll through your bank branch, CSC, or pmfby.gov.in before the sowing season deadline

name: KCC (Kisan Credit Card)
benefit: Short-term credit limit up to ₹3 lakh at 4% interest (with interest subvention)
next_action: Apply at your bank branch or CSC with land records and ID proof

name: PM Kusum (Solar Pump Scheme)
benefit: Subsidy up to 60% for solar pump installation (30% central + 30% state), remaining 40% loan
next_action: Apply through state renewable energy department portal or CSC

name: Soil Health Card Scheme
benefit: Free soil testing and nutrient recommendation card every 2 years
next_action: Contact your district agriculture office or KVK for soil sample collection

name: Maharashtra - Chief Minister Agriculture Solar Feeder Scheme
benefit: Free solar-powered agriculture feeder connection for day-time irrigation
next_action: Apply at MSEDCL office or through mahavitaran.in portal

name: Punjab - Pani Bachao Paise Kamao Scheme
benefit: Incentive of ₹1,500 per acre for direct seeded rice (DSR) water saving
next_action: Register with Punjab Agriculture Department before paddy season

name: Karnataka - Raitha Siri Scheme
benefit: ₹10,000 per hectare incentive for millet cultivation
next_action: Register at Raitha Samparka Kendra or karnataka.gov.in

name: Tamil Nadu - Uzhavar Pathukappu Thittam
benefit: Comprehensive insurance coverage for farmers aged 18-60, premium paid by state
next_action: Enroll at Primary Agriculture Cooperative Society (PACS) or TN agriculture portal

name: Uttar Pradesh - Mukhyamantri Krishak Durghatna Kalyan Yojana
benefit: ₹5 lakh compensation for accidental death/disability of registered farmer
next_action: Register at district agriculture office or upagripardarshi.gov.in

name: Gujarat - Krushi Sahay Yojana
benefit: Subsidy on seeds, fertilizers, and micro-irrigation equipment up to ₹25,000
next_action: Apply at i-Khedut portal (ikhedut.gujarat.gov.in) or Gram Seva Kendra
